**Finding: deviation (WARRANTY) — Section 7.3, ¶p0078**

- **What's there:** A genuine express warranty (Software/MarketSite.net conforms to Documentation, media free from defects, no willfully introduced malicious code) with a real remedy ladder in ¶p0079 — correction, free replacement, and termination with refund of all prepaid fees. The Section 7 disclaimer reaches only implied warranties, so it does not swallow the express warranty.
- **Why it fails the fallback:** Duration only. The Warranty Period is 60 days *from the Effective Date*, hard-capped at December 31, 1999 — below the 90-day software fallback, and worse in practice because Acceptance Testing under Section 3.1 can itself run to December 31, 1999, so the warranty may lapse at or before acceptance.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** Replace the period with "twelve (12) months from Corio's acceptance of the Software pursuant to Section 3.1," deleting the fixed cut-off. Comment offers 90 days from acceptance as the fallback.
